page.layout: One printed page: running head at top with page number left; title heading across full width; engraving (emblem picture) in the centre; four lines of verse centred below the picture; catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: Et Satanas, Mundusq;, Caro, Mors vltimus hostis,
In te vnum ac solum spicula saeua vibrant:
Sed IESVS CHRISTVS VICTOR te flamine sacro-

page.notes: The engraving shows a winged figure with hands raised above a naked man pierced by arrows, standing on a globe marked with crosses; a skeleton archer, a horned devil with a spear, and a figure with a bow stand at left and right; angelic heads in the clouds above. Text of the verse is printed in italic with roman capitals in CHRISTVS VICTOR. The heading words "hominis;" are in smaller italic beneath the title line.
